# External ontology source

`prov-o.ttl` is the unmodified W3C PROV-O ontology retrieved from
[W3C's namespace](https://www.w3.org/ns/prov-o.ttl) on 2026-09-04 (Pacific time).
SHA-256: `7d203989f67b38bca572253942acc5a1bf24ce3ccfece16f072dcb4be2b79a96`.

Specification: [PROV-O Recommendation](https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/).
Copyright belongs to W3C and the contributors identified in the source.
The source retains its original annotations and attribution. See the
[W3C software and document license](https://www.w3.org/copyright/software-license-2023/)
and the notices in the source/specification. This project does not claim
authorship or endorsement of the W3C ontology.

The downloaded schema is real; the operational records in `demo.py` are synthetic.
No full OWL entailment or full PROV constraint conformance is claimed. Execution
checks the selected vocabulary declarations and validates the local SHACL profile.
